essay.title: SECTION B - THEORY
essay.instruction: Answer four (4) questions. Show all necessary workings clearly.

questions.question:
(a) State the principle of floatation and list factors affecting floatation.
(b) A piece of iron weighs 250 N in air and 200 N in a liquid of density 1000 kg m⁻³. Find the volume of the iron. Take g = 10 m s⁻².
(c) The relative density of gold is 19.2. Find the volume of 2.4 kg of gold.

(a) State Boyle's law.
(b) A gas has volume 40 m³ at 327 K and 9.52 × 10⁴ Pa. Calculate its volume at 273 K and 1.034 × 10⁵ Pa.
(c) A gas has volume 76 m³ at 27°C and 800 mmHg. Calculate its volume at STP.

(a) State the principle of conservation of linear momentum and explain linear momentum and elastic collision.
(b) A 12 kg body moving at 4.2 m s⁻¹ collides with an 18 kg body at rest. Find their common velocity if they coalesce.

(a) Explain moment of a force and centre of gravity.
(b) State two applications of moments.
(c) Using the diagram, a uniform 50 cm rod is balanced on fulcrum F by a 200 N force and a 40 N force. Determine the weight of the rod.

(a) State the parallelogram law of vectors.
(b) Determine the resultant vector represented in the first diagram.
(c) Determine the resultant of the forces shown in the second diagram.

(a) Define a machine and the velocity ratio of a pair of gear wheels. State how the mechanical advantage of a gear system can be increased.
(b) For the bicycle gear system shown, determine its velocity ratio. If efficiency is 90%, calculate the effort required to overcome a load of 70 N and explain why the actual effort may be greater.
